5584e643221a3425613f20ede35ceae73fa20ad5.statement: A user gets access to a resource exactly when they are signed in and authorized for it.
5584e643221a3425613f20ede35ceae73fa20ad5.formula: (∀ (x : UserId), (∀ (x_1 : Path), ((access x x_1) = ((signedIn x) ∧ (authorized x x_1)))))

c1f40921583e333254a7a6b27952aadd0712aeab.statement: A request is admitted on behalf of a user only if a grant names that user and the path.
c1f40921583e333254a7a6b27952aadd0712aeab.formula:
(∀ (x : String), (∀ (x_1 : Path), (match (admit x x_1) with | none => True | some x_2 => (Auth.grantFor grants x_2 x_1))))

d43b81fb2fec413382ffff1c298b0f2dde8a6caf.statement: A request is admitted on behalf of the user its token was issued to, exactly when a grant names that user and the path.
d43b81fb2fec413382ffff1c298b0f2dde8a6caf.formula:
(∀ (x : String), (∀ (x_1 : Path), ((admit x x_1) = (List.foldl (fun (x_2 : (Option UserId)) (x_3 : Session) => (if ((x_3.token = x) ∧ (Auth.grantFor grants x_3.user x_1)) then (some x_3.user) else x_2)) (none : (Option UserId)) sessions.«open»))))

  (∃ x_2 ∈ grants, (x_2 = (Grant.mk x x_1)))

a8df76b0605132b2b6e591e2775701057a1d7d97.statement: The session table issues each token to one user.
a8df76b0605132b2b6e591e2775701057a1d7d97.formula:

@[frflow_defs] def tokensIssuedOnce (x : Sessions) : Prop :=
